pairs.target: mǐlā chūfā nàtiān , tǎ wéi dào yuànlǐ shí , tā hái méi shàngchē , zhèng dūn zài liǎngzhī mùxiāng zhōngjiān , bǎ yíshù duǎn mùliào cóng zuǒ xiāng nuó dào yòu xiāng .
pairs.english: On Mira's departure day, when Tavi reached the courtyard she had not boarded yet; crouched between two wooden boxes, she was moving a bundle of short timber from the left box to the right.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉出发那天，塔维到院里时，她还没上车，正蹲在两只木箱中间，把一束短木料从左箱挪到右箱。

pairs.target: chē pángzhàn zhe dàiduì de lǎoshī , shǒulǐ nà zhāng zhǐ bèi fēng xiānqǐ yìjiǎo , tā méiyǒu jiào tā kuài , zhǐ wèn nà shù shìbushì yě jì zài tā yào dài de dōngxī lǐ .
pairs.english: The supervising teacher stood beside the cart, a corner of his sheet lifted by the wind; he did not hurry her, only asked whether that bundle was also recorded among what she meant to bring.
pairs.hanzi: 车旁站着带队的老师，手里那张纸被风掀起一角，他没有叫她快，只问那束是不是也记在她要带的东西里。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō shì , jì zài lìng yìháng , zhàn qǐlái qǔ zhǐ , cái kànjiàn tǎ wéihé yīwén , jiào tāmen xiān bié lái bāng , zìjǐ děi zhīdào nǎyàng fàngdào nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Mira said yes, on another line, and rose to fetch the paper; only then seeing Tavi and Iven, she told them not to help yet; she needed to know what went where herself.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说是，记在另一行，站起来取纸，才看见塔维和伊文，叫他们先别来帮，自己得知道哪样放到哪里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi biàn zài kòng chù tíngxià , zuǒ xī méi wǎng xiāng yán dǐng , yīwén què xiān shēnshǒu zhuōzhù kuài bèi fēngchuī zǒu de shéng tóu , wèn zhège yě yào děng tā zhīdào me .
pairs.english: Tavi stopped in the clear space, his left knee did not press against the box edge; Iven instead first reached to catch a cord end almost blown away by the wind, asking whether this must wait until she knew too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维便在空处停下，左膝没往箱沿顶，伊文却先伸手捉住快被风吹走的绳头，问这个也要等她知道么。

pairs.target: tā táitóu kàn tā , xiào le yíxià , shuō shéng tóu kěyǐ bù děng , suíhòu jiāng yòu xiāng páng yíkuài kòngdì zhǐ gěi tā , jiào tā bié xiān bǎ jié shōu sǐ .
pairs.english: She looked up at him, smiled once and said the cord end need not wait; and then pointed out to him a clear patch beside the right box, telling him not to tighten the knot fully yet.
pairs.hanzi: 她抬头看他，笑了一下，说绳头可以不等，随后将右箱旁一块空地指给他，叫他别先把结收死。

pairs.target: duǎn mùliào shì liú zhe dào le shìchǎng zài àn jiù jià chǐcùn gǎi de , búshì tā yǐjīng rèndìng néng zhuāng shàng de xīn jiǎo jiàn , zuì shàngtóu hái liú zhe yídào méi jù wán de chángxiàn .
pairs.english: The short timber was kept for alteration to the old frame's dimensions after reaching the test yard; it was not a new corner piece she already knew would fit; on top remained a long line not yet sawn through.
pairs.hanzi: 短木料是留着到了试场再按旧架尺寸改的，不是她已经认定能装上的新角件，最上头还留着一道没锯完的长线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn zuórì nà zhī xiǎo kuàng ne , tā shuō liúzài gōngfáng , nàlǐ bù quē yìzhǐ zhīdào chǐcùn de xiǎo kuàng , zìjǐ yào qù kàn de shì nà jià bù zhīdào de .
pairs.english: Tavi then asked about the little model from yesterday; she said it stayed in the workshop, where a model of known dimensions was not lacking; she was going to examine the frame whose dimensions she did not know.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问昨日那只小框呢，她说留在工房，那里不缺一只知道尺寸的小框，自己要去看的是那架不知道的。

alignment.english: whose dimensions she did not know

pairs.target: yīwén jiāng shéng tóu yāzhù , shuō nà dào shěngde gěi tā liú zuò , tā jiào tā huítóu bié bǎ kuàng yě bān dào shítáng qù , zìjǐ hái děi ná tā tóng huílái hòu de dōngxī bǐ .
pairs.english: Iven held down the cord end, saying that indeed saved reserving a seat for it; she told him not to move the model to the dining hall later too, since she still needed to compare it with things brought back.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文将绳头压住，说那倒省得给它留座，她叫他回头别把框也搬到食堂去，自己还得拿它同回来后的东西比。

pairs.target: yǒurén cóng láng kǒu tái chū yìgēn cháng mù , mǐlā zhuǎnshēn rànglù , cháng mù méi wǎng tā de xiāng shàng yā , ér tóng lìng yìgēn bìng zhe , bǎng dào chē cè de jià lǐ .
pairs.english: Someone carried a long beam from the corridor entrance; Mira turned to make way; the beam was not laid on her boxes but placed alongside another and tied into the rack on the cart's side.
pairs.hanzi: 有人从廊口抬出一根长木，米拉转身让路，长木没往她的箱上压，而同另一根并着，绑到车侧的架里。

pairs.target: nà liǎng rén chá de shì yùndào shìchǎng de jià liào , lìng yǒu yìmíng lǎoshī shǒulǐ ná zhe jiù zuò de tuò yàng , tǎ wéi kàn le yízhèn , cái fēnqīng shuí děng shuí shōu hǎo dōngxī .
pairs.english: Those two checked the frame timber being taken to the test yard; there was also a teacher holding a rubbing of the old mounts in hand; Tavi watched a while before distinguishing who was waiting for whom to pack.
pairs.hanzi: 那两人查的是运到试场的架料，另有一名老师手里拿着旧座的拓样，塔维看了一阵，才分清谁等谁收好东西。

pairs.target: mǐlā búshì lǐng zhe tāmen qù de rén , kě tāmen wèn tā chāizhuāng nà dài fàngzài nǎlǐ shí , tā méiyǒu zhuǎntóu zhǎo pángrén , zìjǐ zhǐ le chē nèi kào qián de yíchù .
pairs.english: Mira was not the person leading them, but when they asked her where the disassembly bag went, she did not turn to anyone else; she herself pointed to a place near the front inside the cart.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉不是领着他们去的人，可他们问她拆装那袋放在哪里时，她没有转头找旁人，自己指了车内靠前的一处。

pairs.target: dàikǒu cháo shàng , jiù tú hé gǎiguò de tú jiā zài tóng yíkuài yìngbǎn lǐ , qǔ yìzhāng búyòng jiāng dǐxià de duǎn mùliào quán fānchūlái , tā lākāi dài gěi lǎoshī kànguò cái jì .
pairs.english: The bag opened upward, the old and revised drawings held with the same stiff board; taking one sheet did not require turning out all the short timber beneath; she opened the bag to show the teacher before tying it.
pairs.hanzi: 袋口朝上，旧图和改过的图夹在同一块硬板里，取一张不用将底下的短木料全翻出来，她拉开袋给老师看过才系。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng wèn rúguǒ xiàyǔ zěnmebàn , huàdàozuǐbiān , xiān kànjiàn xiāngdǐ diàn zhe de liǎngtiáo zhǎi mù , yǔzhào yě yǐjīng juǎn zài dài páng , méiyǒu ná zhǐ qù tì tā dǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to ask what to do if it rained; with words on his lips, he first saw the box bottoms padded with two narrow wooden strips, the rain cover already rolled beside the bag too, with no paper used to shield it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想问如果下雨怎么办，话到嘴边，先看见箱底垫着的两条窄木，雨罩也已经卷在袋旁，没有拿纸去替它挡。

pairs.target: tā réng wèn le , mǐlā shuō ruò yǔ dà dào kànbùqīng jìhào , biàn xiān tíng , búshì tóu yìtiān méi liángwán , dìèrtiān yě děi zhào zhǐ shàng wǎng xià zuò .
pairs.english: He asked anyway; Mira said if the rain grew too heavy to read the marks, then first stop; failure to finish measuring on day one did not mean day two must still follow the paper's plan to carry on.
pairs.hanzi: 他仍问了，米拉说若雨大到看不清记号，便先停，不是头一天没量完，第二天也得照纸上往下做。

pairs.target: dàiduì de lǎoshī tīngjiàn , shuō xiān kàn chǎngdì hé jiù zuò , zài juédìng xiè nǎ yìxiāng , mǐlā diǎntóu , jiāng chāizhuāng jìlù nà zhāng zhǐ huàn dào dàikǒu cháowài de yímiàn .
pairs.english: The supervising teacher heard, saying first inspect the ground and old mounts, then decide which box to unload; Mira nodded, moving the disassembly record, that sheet, to face outward at the bag opening.
pairs.hanzi: 带队的老师听见，说先看场地和旧座，再决定卸哪一箱，米拉点头，将拆装记录那张纸换到袋口朝外的一面。

pairs.target: yīwén hūrán wèn zìjǐ nàtiān ruò yě méi wèn wán zěnmebàn , mǐlā shuō nà jiù liú zhe wèn , bié wèile děng tā huílái chīfàn , xiān tì biérén dá shàng .
pairs.english: Iven suddenly asked what he should do if he also had unanswered questions that day; Mira said then keep asking, do not answer for others in advance just to wait for her return to dinner.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文忽然问自己那天若也没问完怎么办，米拉说那就留着问，别为了等她回来吃饭，先替别人答上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhuǎntóu kàn tā , yīwén shuō bó huò fáng yuē dào hòu rì xiàwǔ , zuórì yǒurén huí le huà , zìjǐ dài fù yè qù , xiān wèn nà liǎngrì shìcóng nǎ yíchù jì qǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi turned to look at him; Iven said the berth-office appointment was the afternoon after next, someone had replied yesterday; he would take the duplicate and first ask where those two days were counted from.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维转头看他，伊文说泊货房约到后日下午，昨日有人回了话，自己带副页去，先问那两日是从哪一处记起。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn yào buyào shāo hǎoxiāoxī huílái , tā shuō bù yídìng yǒu , tā shuō nà shāo gè bùhǎo tīng de yě xíng , suíhòu shēnshǒu jiāng tā méi jì de shéng tóu ná le guòqù .
pairs.english: Mira asked would he bring back good news; he said there might not be any; she said then unwelcome news would do too, and reached to take the cord end he had left untied.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问要不要捎好消息回来，他说不一定有，她说那捎个不好听的也行，随后伸手将他没系的绳头拿了过去。

pairs.target: shéngjié shōu hǎo shí , chēfū yǐjīng zuòshàngqù , lǎoshī yòu jiào guò yíbiàn míngzì , mǐlā yìngshēng , qǔ qǐ zìjǐ de xiǎobāo , méiyǒu bǎ tú dài yě yìqǐ bào zài huáilǐ .
pairs.english: When the knot was secured, the driver was already seated; the teacher called the names again, Mira answered and picked up her own small bag, without hugging the drawing bag as well.
pairs.hanzi: 绳结收好时，车夫已经坐上去，老师又叫过一遍名字，米拉应声，取起自己的小包，没有把图袋也一起抱在怀里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ràngkāi jiǎo biān nà kuài diànmù , méi tì tā tíbāo , zhǐ wèn huílái shìbushì hái zài zhèlǐ děng , tā shuō xiān dào gōngfáng fàng dōngxī , bié èzhedùzi děng chē .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped clear of the packing wood by his feet, without carrying her bag, only asking whether to wait here again on her return; she said first put things in the workshop, do not wait for the cart while hungry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维让开脚边那块垫木，没替她提包，只问回来是不是还在这里等，她说先到工房放东西，别饿着肚子等车。

pairs.target: tā shàngchē yǐhòu yòu tàntóu chūlái , wèn gānliáng yǒuméiyǒu tóng duǎn mùliào bǎng dào yìqǐ , yīwén shuō zìjǐ méi tì tā dǎbāo , tā bǎ bāo kǒu bākāi kàn le yìyǎn , cháo tāmen bǎishǒu , shuō rújīn zhīdào le .
pairs.english: After boarding she leaned out again, asking had the dry food been tied with the short timber; Iven said he had not packed for her; she opened her bag and looked inside once, waved to them, saying now she knew.
pairs.hanzi: 她上车以后又探头出来，问干粮有没有同短木料绑到一起，伊文说自己没替她打包，她把包口扒开看了一眼，朝他们摆手，说如今知道了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe wǎnghòu ràng , chē cè de cháng mù cóng tā yǎnqián mànmàn guò , liǎnggè tái mù de rén yǐjīng rào dào chē hòu , lǎoshī zuìhòu shōuqǐ zhǐ , zuò dào kào wài de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled and stepped back; the long beams on the cart's side passed slowly before his eyes, both timber carriers already round the back; the teacher finally put away the sheet and sat at the outside edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着往后让，车侧的长木从他眼前慢慢过，两个抬木的人已经绕到车后，老师最后收起纸，坐到靠外的位置。

pairs.target: yuànmén kāi zhe , chē méiyǒu cóng zhōngjiān nà dào gāo kǎn zǒu , zhuǎn qù cèbiān de huǎn dào , mǐlā zài dài páng nuó le nuó jiǎo , gěi lìngyìrén ràngchū fàng xī de dìfāng .
pairs.english: The courtyard gate stood open; the cart avoided the high step in the middle, turning onto the gentle side path; Mira shifted her feet beside the bag to give another passenger room for their knees.
pairs.hanzi: 院门开着，车没有从中间那道高坎走，转去侧边的缓道，米拉在袋旁挪了挪脚，给另一人让出放膝的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zǒu dào ménbiān biàn tíng , yīwén zài tā shēnpáng kàn le yíhuìer , wèn yào buyào qù chīfàn , tā diǎntóu , cái fāxiànzìjǐ shǒulǐ hái niē zhe yìgēn cóng xiāng jiǎo shíqǐ de sǎn shéng .
pairs.english: Tavi went to the gate and stopped; Iven watched beside him a while, asking whether to go eat; he nodded, only then noticing his hand still gripping something from a box corner: a loose cord he had picked up.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维走到门边便停，伊文在他身旁看了一会儿，问要不要去吃饭，他点头，才发现自己手里还捏着一根从箱角拾起的散绳。

pairs.target: tā bǎ shéng fàng huí ménpáng de kōng lán lǐ , méiyǒu dàizǒu dāng gè shénme , zhuǎnguòshēn , yīwén zhèngzài chēn lǐngkǒu , nà dào xīn féng guò de dìfāng bú dàpíng , què yǐjīng búzài zhāng zhe kǒu .
pairs.english: He put the cord back in the empty basket by the door, without carrying it off as some keepsake, and turned; Iven was tugging his collar, the newly sewn spot not quite flat, but already no longer gaping.
pairs.hanzi: 他把绳放回门旁的空篮里，没有带走当个什么，转过身，伊文正在抻领口，那道新缝过的地方不大平，却已经不再张着口。
